review:
The fruit formula with a 10-spin cycle. Golden wild frames build up and multipliers grow during each cycle, and on the 10th spin every frame you've collected turns wild.

Free spins bring sticky wilds, and you can buy starts with 2x2 or 3x3 wild blocks. Medium-low volatility, a 3,000x max and 97% RTP, with free spins about once every 148 spins. That 10th spin is always worth watching.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 148 spins on average)
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
